headline: DoorDash to Acquire Instacart in $17 Billion Deal
summary: DoorDash has agreed to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, offering $65 per share in cash—a 26% premium over its pre-announcement trading price—to consolidate the food and grocery delivery sector.
why: Both DoorDash and Instacart are major operators in the North American gig economy and delivery sector. Industry consolidation alters competitive dynamics and fee structures for merchants and consumers.

impacts.name: DoorDash
impacts.why: Acquiring a major competitor involves substantial capital outlays and regulatory scrutiny, impacting short-term cash flow and long-term market share.

why_moved: A multi-billion dollar acquisition at a significant premium directly reprices the target company's shares to match the buyout offer while changing capital allocation expectations for the acquirer.
